mentions.note: Club Captain; won the Haig & Haig Challenge Cup in 1898 and twice more, retaining it outright

photos.c: Left: Sam Sherrington (front marker) at a handicap meeting before the turn of the century.

Right: Sam Sherrington, seated right, with team-mates after a successful handicap meeting. The man behind Sam is probably W.C. Berridge who won the Haig Cup in 1901. If anyone can identify the others the Editor would be pleased to know.

photo.caption: Left: Sam Sherrington (front marker) at a handicap meeting before the turn of the century.
